That feels right. Searching for "moon cheese" gave me a clear "No bookmarks found" message with 0 results, instead of pretending it found something by showing me loosely-related stuff I didn't ask for. I'd rather have a plain, honest "nothing matches" than the app quietly loosening what I typed and handing me things that aren't really it — that would just make me doubt whether my search worked at all.

And the little clear button stayed right there, so I can wipe the search and get my whole collection back in one tap. That's exactly the recovery I'd want. This is good.
